title: tovomita macrophylla
intro: Tovomita macrophylla, commonly known as the "Gutta" plant, is a type of plant that belongs to the Clusiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Tovomita macrophylla are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
